# Image

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders JPEG or PNG image data as a document element.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IAltTextProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Image(options?: ImageOptions)
```

- [`imageData`](#imagedata): Raw image data (mutually exclusive with filePath)

- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
- [`width`](#width): Desired display width in points (null = auto).

### `altText`

```typescript
altText: string
```

Alternate text description for accessibility. When the document opts into `AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`, this populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element wrapping the image. Required by PDF/UA for non-decorative figures.

Example, from `code-recipes/long-form-typesetting/dickens-novel`:

```typescript
plateImage.altText =
```

Example, from `code-recipes/images-svg-colour/images`:

```typescript
photo.altText = name;
```

### `filePath`

```typescript
filePath: string
```

Path to image file (mutually exclusive with imageData)

### `fitMode`

```typescript
fitMode: ImageFitMode
```

How the image fills its box. Accepts the enum or a token like `'cover'`.

Example, from `code-recipes/images-svg-colour/images`:

```typescript
image.fitMode = fitMode;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/images-svg-colour/images`:

```typescript

```

Example, from `industry-templates/field-service-property/site-inspection-report`:


### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative: boolean
```

When `true`, the image is purely decorative and is tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning. Set explicitly for decorative borders, dividers, and background imagery.

Example, from `industry-templates/retail-events/event-ticket`:

```typescript
img.isDecorative = true;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/annual-report`:

```typescript
hero.isDecorative = true;
```

### `keepResolution`

```typescript
keepResolution: boolean
```

When `true`, the image is embedded at its source resolution regardless of the document's `maxImageDpi`. If the same image is placed more than once, one placement with this set keeps the whole embedded copy at full resolution.

### `maintainAspectRatio`

```typescript
maintainAspectRatio: boolean
```

Whether to maintain aspect ratio (ignored for Fill mode)

## Methods

- [`needsAsyncDecode`](#needsasyncdecode): True when this image carries raw PNG bytes that have not yet been decoded.
- [`prepareAsync`](#prepareasync): Asynchronously decode the image and cache its `ImageInfo`.

### `needsAsyncDecode`

```typescript
needsAsyncDecode(): boolean
```

True when this image carries raw PNG bytes that have not yet been decoded.  Used by the document async-preload phase to discover which images need a `prepareAsync()` call before the sync render pass runs.

### `prepareAsync`

```typescript
prepareAsync(): Promise<void>
```

Asynchronously decode the image and cache its `ImageInfo`.  Required for real-world (Huffman-compressed) PNGs, because the sync loader only handles stored-block PNGs.  `Document.generateBytesAsync()` calls this automatically during its preload phase; you only need to invoke it yourself if you intend to call `generateBytes()` (sync) on a document containing PNG images decoded from arbitrary sources.

No-ops if the image is already prepared, or if `imageData` is a JPEG (JPEGs need no decompression - their bytes pass straight into `/DCTDecode`).
